comment: Design 14: the parent's icon and colour choices for an app on the kid's launcher. Identical copies in server/testdata and launcher/app/src/test/resources; scripts/material-symbols.sh makes the glyphs and both runtime tables from this file. icons: key -> Material Symbols Rounded name (filled, 24 px). colors: key -> seed and tile (the launcher's tileColor(seed): white on it >= 3:1).
